method: Fresh processes, five warm repeats after the first invocation. Default mode runs in A-B-B-A order (A main3575a3e, B candidate). Enabled mode measures forward and full checkpointed backward separately. GPU isolation checked before/after every run.
scope: Input upload, 32-query centered-field evaluation, validation and meshing excluded from timed regions. Backward includes all replay stages and input gradients. Pool peak includes process inputs/checkpoints; native CUDA graph storage is outside the pool.
default_gate: No consistent latency regression across two order-balanced rounds; identical peak pool bytes for all default A/B runs in each case. Earlier round differs only in optional solver_adjoint.py, which default reconstruction never imports.
